notes:
v0.6.25: fix lxmf module name in reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh verify.

The lxmf PyPI package installs with module name 'LXMF' (uppercase),
not 'lxmf' (lowercase). The script's verify check used
'import lxmf' which fails with ModuleNotFoundError even though
lxmf is correctly installed at /home/pi/.local/pipx/venvs/rns/
lib/python3.11/site-packages/LXMF/.

Fix: change the import to 'import LXMF' (uppercase). The package
name on PyPI is still 'lxmf' (so pipx inject rns lxmf works),
but the Python module is uppercase.

Same pattern: the launcher's component check (collect-box-status.sh)
uses `python -m pip list` which reports the package name, not the
module name, so it's not affected by this. Only the script's
verify check needed the fix.
